title: Teriyaki Chicken Wrap
description: A twist on traditional Japanese flavors with a hearty Peruvian chicken wrap. Marinated chicken, crunchy veggies, and savory sauce come together for a delicious meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Add the chicken breasts and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
2. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Assemble the wraps by spreading a quarter cup of sushi rice onto each tortilla, followed by sliced chicken, cucumber, carrots, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
